title: DecentBusking Live Audio Pilot Agreement v1
status: Draft for joint review. Not approved or pinned by inclusion in the repository.
scope: Only a dated booking identifying this exact document URI and hash, the guaranteed pilot policy, performer wallet and agreed duration.
terms: Mission: rehearse the invitation, soundchecks, live audio delivered through DecentBusking website radio, review and performer claim. Video, audience size and ticket sales are not required. The booked start and duration are fixed in the signed invitation.

Guaranteed pilot fee: $20 native USDC on Base (8453), independent of rehearsal coverage, failed soundchecks, technical problems, no verified start or cancellation. The rehearsal ladder never reduces this pilot fee. Prep-task payments and any supporter gift are separate offers, not assets held by the performance escrow.

Soundchecks: attend private checks 60 and 15 minutes before the booked start. The operator verifies input and actual listener delivery. Both must pass before going on air. A failed check blocks public broadcast but does not reduce this pilot fee.

Rehearsal ladder only: 0% without a verified start; 10% at a qualified, verified on-air start; the other nine 10% steps occur at equal verified-time intervals through the first 75% of the booked duration. Each interval is one twelfth of the whole slot. For 20 minutes: $2 simulated at start, then another $2 every 100 verified seconds, reaching $20 at 900 seconds (15 minutes). No intermediate on-chain transfers occur.

Coverage: whole verified live-audio seconds inside the booked window. Soundchecks, disconnected time and audio outside the window do not count. Reconnected intervals resume, not restart or double-count. Intentional musical silence is not a transport failure. Operator observations and media delivery evidence are reviewed transparently; the smart contract does not hear the performance.

Interruption: show RECONNECTING during recovery. After 60 consecutive seconds without verified audio delivery, cancel the broadcast, announce it, show a brief fault slate, then give eligible DVert adverts a ten-minute recovery window before normal radio. There is no guarantee of available adverts and no credit for undelivered plays. Cancellation of broadcast/schedule does not cancel the guaranteed financial obligation.

Settlement: use per-booking LivePerformanceEscrow on Base. Keep the funded booking intact even if the schedule is cancelled. After the original booked end, the steward records an honest rehearsal report and approves 100% within the 24-hour review window. Performer claims from their own wallet with Base ETH for gas. Target prompt approval; network or service delays may prevent immediate claimability.

Contract limitations: before review ends, escrow approval is an administrator action, not an automatic guarantee or coverage oracle. With no decision after the review window, the full fee becomes claimable. Claim deadline is three days after that window; expiry can return unclaimed funds to the funder. Emergency pause blocks claims and refunds. The contract still permits pre-show cancellation: performer cancellation or steward cancellation more than eight hours early refunds the funder; late steward cancellation uses a 100% kill fee for this pilot. Do not use financial cancellation for a broadcast failure. If a direct cancellation, refund, mistaken partial approval or expiry defeats the agreed $20 payment, the steward owes the shortfall separately and records its receipt without pretending the escrow paid it.

Additional offer: only the exact additional-offer text in the signed booking applies. It is not escrow funding, a token transfer or a completed payroll payment. Prep-task pay does not depend on Friday's technical success. No supporter purchase, coding work or audience recruitment is required to perform.

Content and rights: use original or properly licensed audio. No harassment, hate speech or unlawful content. The performer retains ownership and grants permission to transmit this agreed live audio set. Recording, archiving, promotional clips, artwork and video require separate explicit consent; this pilot grants none by default.

Changes and disputes: changed dates or terms require a new agreement and fresh consent, without extinguishing an existing guaranteed obligation. Raise problems directly with the steward and retain minimal public settlement evidence; do not publish private conversations or credentials. Tips are separate; each party handles applicable taxes.
